A vibrant ancient Jerusalem street scene showing early Christians in fellowship. In the foreground, a wealthy believer is handing a bag of coins to an apostle. In the background, small groups of believers are happily sharing bread and a meal at a wooden table outside a stone house. The atmosphere is joyful and peaceful.

A split-panel illustration. Left panel: Peter standing with a stern face pointing at Ananias, who has fallen to the ground dead with coins spilling from a pouch, while bystanders look on in shock. Right panel: Seven diverse men standing in a line; the apostles are laying hands on the head of Stephen, who is kneeling.
